correctness.rationale: The listed nondegenerate tuples exhaust the inclusive cutoff: each nondegenerate step uses at least one unit of length, and a backtrack is not a degeneracy. At cutoff two the oriented-edge pair for each underlying edge has two backtrack disks. Using one disk removes the reverse edge, and the other attaches by a nullhomotopic loop. Each directed distance-two shortcut is removed using its unique length-two disk, uniqueness following from no four-cycle. The remaining non-backtrack disks are precisely the six ordered triangle disks per triangle. One disk removes a triangle edge and the five remaining boundary loops become nullhomotopic. These are homotopy substitutions, not just boundary-matrix operations: at each step the chosen disk has a single boundary arc mapping to the eliminated edge and the rest stays in the retained one-skeleton; this pair retracts to the retained subcomplex before the other disks are attached along the induced loops. Replacing nullhomotopic attaching maps by constant maps gives spheres. Triangle edge sets are disjoint and alternate paths preserve connectivity on every removal. The same edge removal collapses each filled triangle in the clique complex; no larger clique exists. The remaining graph thus gives e−v+1−t circles and the ordered cells give e+5t spheres. In the single-vertex case both counts are zero. The triangle sharing an entire edge with the pentagon checks the noncactus qualification.
residual_risks: The finite homology checks do not by themselves show homotopy type; it is the elimination of attaching loops that does. The homotopy splitting is not asserted natural or equivariant.

value.rationale: This is an explicit integral homotopy type at a natural early filtration stage, not an Euler characteristic or a table of examples. The theorem separates the graph clique core from the spheres contributed by the ordered cells, and isolates the effect of both triangles and the four-cycle obstruction. It covers arbitrary cycle overlap with longer cycles and is not restricted to one-point gluing.
residual_risks: No natural splitting, group action, or persistent map classification is credited.
